title: ChatGPT-optimized session compression
changes: Significantly reduced session size for ChatGPT by aggressively filtering localStorage to only essential auth/session keys.
ChatGPT-specific optimization: sessionStorage is now excluded entirely, preventing large non-essential payloads.
Cookie filtering refined to keep only required authentication cookies while dropping analytics and bot-related data.
Improved Firestore reliability – optimized payloads now stay safely under the 1 MB document size limit for supported sites.
Internal copy logic refactored to avoid MV3 module import issues, restoring full popup responsiveness and button reliability.
No functional changes for non-ChatGPT websites – existing copy/paste behavior remains unchanged.
